decision.reasoning:
Tested-point scope, not a range claim. Of the three planned configurations, exactly one new changed configuration is fully evaluated: batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1 (control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight=0.3, terminal_tip_speed_weight=0.0). Proposal 0 (holding 0.05 / terminal 0.0 = improvement-96f0ade35119) is reused historical evidence, and proposal 2 (holding 0.0 / terminal 0.0) was never executed — the batch stopped (material_scheduler_failure_retained_baseline_reexecution, candidate batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-2) with no sealed simulation/evaluation/profile. I therefore do not claim two fully evaluated new candidates.

Sealed observations. Baseline-replay passes terminal reach (terminal_error_m 0.007643 < 0.01 m) and fails holding (holding_max_error_m 0.058138 vs 0.01 m; holding_max_speed_m_s 1.581015 vs 0.02 m/s); joint_reach_holding_passed false. Candidate improvement-96f0ade35119 passes reach (0.008699 m), fails holding (0.056505 m; 1.175005 m/s), joint false; against the frozen baseline it is classified physical_tradeoff (holding error -0.001634 m and speed -0.406010 m/s improved; terminal error +0.001056 m worsened). The one new changed candidate batch-2ef6ee45913c43c9-1 fails terminal reach (0.018690 > 0.01 m) and fails holding (0.063444 m; 1.127628 m/s); joint false. No evaluated configuration achieves joint reach+holding success.

Interpretation. No candidate strictly improves (each is a tradeoff, fails reach, or is unresolved) and none joins reach+holding, so no candidate is promotable.

Recommendation vs candidate, kept separate. Recommendation disposition: adopt — I accept the retained diagnostic recommendation to defer causal attribution and defer further weight tuning (recommendation_id rec-defer-weight-tuning), asserting no parameter value and recommending no further weight search and no different diagnostic check now, i.e. no execution is authorized. Candidate selection is a separate axis: candidate_disposition retain_baseline, selected_candidate baseline — the frozen baseline is retained because no evaluated candidate is jointly better, and the pilot's incomplete second attempt supplies no sealed result.

Hypotheses with scope. tendon.force_limit_saturation is weakened at the sampled points (max sampled channel 7.999998 N <= 8.0 N per-tendon limit; force_bound_violation_n 0.0), and is only partially tested rather than refuted across the 27 unqueried updates. controller.compute_budget_saturated and solver.termination_limited remain plausible from controller-side plan records (User_Requested_Stop / budget_best_feasible; optimization_selected_iteration 0; effective_horizon truncating 7/5/3/1 over the final interval) but such plan values do not establish a physical cause. hold.tip_speed_penalty_insufficient remains unresolved because no per-term cost contributions are retained. No dominant settling cause is established: a single execution, one paired tradeoff, and closed-loop counterfactual replay is capability_unavailable.

Limitations and independently stated next action. The holding window covers only the final 0.05 s with no continuous-time guarantee and real_time_demonstrated false; the second batch attempt has no sealed result and contributes zero complete new configurations. Recommendation dispositions and candidate selection are separate; the diagnostic deferrals authorize no execution. Proposed next action: finish — no further tuning, check, or backend run is authorized. Raw termination is kept distinct from convergence, wall deadlines from simulated steps, applied updates from optimized selections, and terminal reach from holding. These are observations and derived sealed arithmetic, not causal, statistical, global, real-time or hardware claims.
